system.description:
Jungle/island guerrilla tradition, hit and vanish.

  • Vanishing Shot: After making a ranged attack while moving, you can Hide as part of your movement (see Disengage & Hide in The Arneyan Codex) if any cover or foliage is within reach. The Hide check still applies.
  • Island Craft: Advantage on Fletcher's Craft checks using improvised/natural materials rather than proper tools.
